narrative: The WorldEvolver paper's inference-time self-evolving memory and NVIDIA's Secure Agent Workspace both touch the agent-harness layer the trifecta-gate thesis lives on, but neither ships the load-bearing mechanism: a default-on gate capping the lethal trifecta of private-data access, untrusted content, and external communication. WorldEvolver improves prediction quality, not deny-by-default authorization, so the link is thematic, not direct evidence.
remaining_gap: No coding-agent platform has shipped a default-on deny-by-default authorization gate constraining the three trifecta capabilities.
